dimensions.name: 10_footprint_the_bar_writes_only_inside_its_own_temp_root
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run of the frozen bar (python3 tests/test_v099_instrument1.py in the job root, exit 0, 14/14, ~2.0 s). The bar's footprint control proved its write gate lands a permitted write inside a private temp root, refused a write aimed at the subject's tests/ with no bytes left behind and no write recorded, and left every file of a full copy of the subject at identical bytes.

dimensions.name: 11_bytes_move_no_stored_record_changes_while_the_bar_runs
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. Every stored record under record/ (16 *.json kept records, e.g. custody-v0.9.3..v0.9.7) hashed identically before and after a full pass of the bar's measurement functions, and the plant that rewrites one on a copy was caught by the same comparison. No custody-v0.9.9.json exists on disk, so the artifact wrote no record (Instrument 2's file, correctly untouched).

dimensions.name: 13_every_green_at_base_case_bites
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. Every measurement function named a contentless planted tree rather than returning [] or raising vacuously, count_problems() refused a tree with no count.py with a real error, and the live README stale-token plant reddened measure_documents_clean through the same assert_bites helper the other cases use.

dimensions.name: 14_the_version_is_read_from_the_document_and_never_from_a_flag
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. The bar's code body (module docstring excluded) carries no 0.x.y literal other than the cited GAP_EXCEPTIONS release 0.9.8 and reads neither the environment nor argv; release_version() followed a planted 9.8.7 header.

dimensions.name: 00_the_release_lands
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. measure_release_lands(subject) returned [] on the artifact: SPEC.md declares **Version 0.9.9 · candidate · 2026-11-12**, strictly later than the base 0.9.8 derived from git show 534d8738:SPEC.md (not a literal), CHANGELOG.md's newest entry is 0.9.9, both examples declare 0.9.9, the header date is a real past day strictly later than the base header's 2026-11-04, and no record/RECORD-GAP-v0.9.9.md exists (only the exception's RECORD-GAP-v0.9.8.md). All five sensitivity bites ran and bit on planted copies.

dimensions.name: 01_spec_header_is_the_release_with_a_real_past_date
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. The header names 0.9.9 with a status word, is dated 2026-11-12 (past, strictly later than the base header's 2026-11-04), SPEC.md section 4's specVersion example names 0.9.9, and the newest CHANGELOG entry agrees with the header. The future-date and mismatched-example bites both bit.

dimensions.name: 02_count_py_green_except_the_record
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. I also ran python3 tools/count.py on the artifact tree directly: it reports exactly one problem, the named record problem ('release 0.9.9 has no record/custody-v0.9.9.json and no record/RECORD-GAP-v0.9.9.md saying why'), which is Instrument 2's file and required to be carried and named here; no stale/gap/other problems. Both bites (planted gap note, planted stale token) bit. NOTE on a PRIOR, not on this artifact: the packet's ground_truth claims test_02 is also RED at base; my own base measurement (clone of this job root at HEAD 2ad7dc2, bar bytes verified 11c7dc71…) gives FAILED (failures=1), test_00 red and test_02 green at base, matching the bar's own docstring (line 102-103). The bar is red at base under both readings, so the gate's polarity holds; the discrepancy is in the packet's PRIOR entry, not in the artifact and not in the frozen bar.

dimensions.name: 03_count_py_maker_problems_are_gone
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. measure_count_maker_problems(subject) returned []: count.py's report on the artifact tree carries no stale version token and no gap-not-permitted problem for 0.9.9. The record problem present in count.py's output is Instrument 2's and is deliberately not required by this case.

dimensions.name: 04_every_example_declares_the_release
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. Both examples/minimal/inputs.json and examples/minimal/record.json declare specVersion 0.9.9, and tests/example_version_check.py exited 0 over the artifact tree.

dimensions.name: 05_no_requirement_changed
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. SPEC.md's movement is confined to its header line and the version token inside section 4's specVersion example cell: all 26 section-5 requirement rows compare id-for-id and text-for-text against git show 534d8738:SPEC.md, every other section-4 cell (field, type, required?, notes) is the base commit's with the required? answer compared by its normalised value, and no other text moved under the masked whole-body comparison. The required-cell flip, reworded-example-prose, type-cell and CL1-10-weakening plants all bit.

dimensions.name: 06_cadence_amendment_and_the_no_requirement_claim
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. CONTRIBUTING.md's Releases section carries the Owner's cadence amendment verbatim ('a release that changes no requirement does not count toward the monthly cadence', read across a line wrap), and CHANGELOG.md's 0.9.9 entry opens '**No requirement changed.**' with no requirement id under **Breaking**. The wrapped-removal, unwrapped-removal and contradicting-entry plants all bit.

dimensions.name: 07_contributing_names_v098_and_carries_no_token_count_py_reads
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. CONTRIBUTING.md no longer carries the bare 0.9.8 token (or any other non-release token count.py reads); the rewritten sentence still states the fact — the release before this one shipped without a record — and names where the note is kept (record/). The claim arm verified on a planted cut tree that a false sentence naming THIS release as shipping without a record is refused, while the honest rewrite clears both the bar and count.py. Deletion-of-sentence, deletion-of-paragraph and re-planted-token plants all bit.

dimensions.name: 08_readme_contributing_draft_note_are_consistent
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. The tree is cut (0.9.9 vs base 0.9.8), so the zero verdict applied: DRAFT-NOTE.md's hunk inventory lists only the seven editable documents (CHANGELOG, CONTRIBUTING, DRAFT-NOTE, README, SPEC, the two examples) and measure_draft_note_claims_frozen returned zero frozen-path claims; README.md's **Status: v0.9.9, candidate.** agrees with SPEC.md; all required base phrases survive in README/CONTRIBUTING/DRAFT-NOTE. The inventory-line, prose-claim and bump-only-note plants all bit, and the cleared-note fix was accepted.

dimensions.name: 09_every_current_document_is_clean
dimensions.observation: Passed in my run. No current document (README, CONTRIBUTING, DRAFT-NOTE, GOVERNANCE, SECURITY, NOTICE, PATENTS, SPEC) or example carries a version token other than 0.9.9; only the repository's two license names appear; every digest in examples/minimal/record.json matched the sha256 of the bytes of the file it names (resolved through inputs.json); and the frozen tools/check_verdicts.py exited 0 over the example record. The stale-token, second-license, zeroed-subject-digest and missing-file plants all bit.
